Topic: Pure Fourier Series: Decoding the Language of Waves

Target audience: University students (Engineering/Physics/Mathematics)

Section: section_1 — The Hook: The Musical Analogy

Lecture lines:
Complex periodic signals are just chords of sine waves.
A cat’s purr reveals a base and harmonics.
Chaotic waves resolve into ordered stacks of harmonics.

Planned animations:
Display a musical staff with scattered notes appearing. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Animate notes coalescing into a single clear melody line. (Color: #FFFF00)
Highlight the melody line with a vibrant pulse. (Color: #00FFFF)

Section: section_2 — The Core Concept: Defining Fourier Series

Lecture lines:
Periodic f(x) decomposes into sums of sines and cosines.
Fourier coefficients represent the weight of each frequency.
Think of it like a harmonic light mixer.

Planned animations:
Draw a periodic square wave on the screen. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Show a single sine wave overlapping the square wave. (Color: #FF00FF)
Add more sine waves, amplitude decreasing, to approximate the square. (Color: #00FF00)

Section: section_3 — Visualizing Coefficients: The Integration Trick

Lecture lines:
Orthogonality allows us to sift specific frequency components.
Integration acts as a tuner for frequencies.
This isolates pure signals from the static air.

Planned animations:
Display the integral formula for coefficients. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Highlight the orthogonality property in the formula with a box. (Color: #FF0000)
Show sine wave product reducing to a single peak. (Color: #FFFF00)

Section: section_4 — Step-by-Step Construction: Synthesis

Lecture lines:
Summing harmonics builds complex waves piece by piece.
Adding more terms reveals sharp square wave edges.
Gibbs phenomenon appears at the sharp corners.

Planned animations:
Start with a flat line base. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Add fundamental frequency sine wave, emphasizing the wave. (Color: #FFFF00)
Add second harmonic wave, showing vertical stacking. (Color: #00FFFF)
Display final sum, emphasizing the resulting shape. (Color: #FF00FF)
Show wave converging towards the target shape. (Color: #00FF00)

Lecture lines:
We map signals from time into frequency domains.
Noise-canceling headphones neutralize drone frequencies instantly.
Fourier analysis transforms our digital, modern world.
